title: 🚗💨 “If ‘God is in control’ means you never touch the brakes of repentance… you might just be riding shotgun with your ego.” 😅
paragraphs: 🚗💨 “If ‘God is in control’ means you never touch the brakes of repentance… you might just be riding shotgun with your ego.” 😅

God’s not your co-pilot — He’s the Lord of the road, not your bumper sticker.
#LetGoOfTheWheel
Luke 6:46 — “Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and do not do what I say?”
